answer: Pay agents in proportion to the diversity of their counterparties, not raw volume: money from a fresh, unrelated partner counts fully, while transfers inside a closed cluster are discounted steeply. A sybil operator can spawn a hundred fake identities, but like a glacier carving a single valley, their trades all run through the same narrow channel, and the discount sees that bottleneck. Keys of ferrous strength bind each identity to one signing key, so the ring cannot relabel itself, and a raven circling above the payment graph needs no private data to spot the flock.
